trades.name: Hold of 6716-6719 (or 6719-6721)
trades.quote: Long a hold of ES 6716-6719 (or the weekly 19-21) targeting 28.5-32.25 and today’s high with continuation. The reason I can’t rate this highly is because this move higher still requires some kind of confirmation.

trades.name: Hold of 24844-24856 (reluctant)
trades.quote: I have an even harder time longing NQ on a hold of 844-856 as value overlapped lower today. I need to be convinced/

trades.name: Firm bid in 6702-6711
trades.quote: I am willing to attempt a long if we see a firm bid come into the tape in the 6702-6711 range. I know this is a wide range which is what makes it difficult to rate. It is effectively bulls one chance to precent a trip to today’s low and rip back above 6716-6719.

trades.name: Firm bid in 24760-24800
trades.quote: The same is true of NQ in the 760-800 range or so. Again, an absurdly wide range but considered demand until proven otherwise. Again, I need to see it real time.

trades.name: LBAF of IB low (inside day, IB low above 6702-6711)
trades.quote: Regarding the above two trades, we know that sellers need traction below today’s low so if we are trading an inside day and set the IB low somewhere above the above referenced ranges, then a LBAF the IB low (for example) would be an ideal and risk-defined way to express a bullish bias.
